title: Upper Density Theorem on ℝ^Q: zero n-density of a locally finite weighted measure off its carrier (Simon Ch. 1, 3.6, 3.7(2))
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^Q, let S ⊆ ℝ^Q be Hⁿ-null-measurable, and let g : ℝ^Q → [0, ∞] satisfy ∫⁻_{S∩K} g dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^Q. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. y with y ∉ S, (∫⁻_{S ∩ B̄_ρ(y)} g dHⁿ) / ENNReal.ofReal(ρⁿ) → 0 in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0+, where B̄_ρ(y) = closedBall y ρ.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (S : Set (Eucl Q)) (g : Eucl Q → ℝ≥0∞), NullMeasurableSet S (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → ∫⁻ x in S ∩ K, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) < ∞) → ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)), y ∉ S → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in S ∩ closedBall y ρ, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
